output.summary: Arts' 9-day median is mostly explained by SlotBook tickets (42% of Arts tickets) sent to the P4 best-effort queue under RR-17, with a 17-day median wait before first action. The remaining gap comes from Tuesday/Thursday-only on-site cover at Lindqvist. Like-for-like Arts and non-Arts remote tickets are within 0.3 days, so deprioritisation of Arts is contradicted. Duplicate rates are similar, so trivial or duplicate filing is contradicted. The P4 acknowledgement gives no priority or timeframe. Whether ITS told Arts leadership of RR-17 is undetermined: a meeting occurred but no record of its content exists. The SSO link to the SlotBook rise is confounded by term start. A written support agreement and a clearer acknowledgement are low-regret. Moving all Arts tickets to P4, or setting up a separate Arts desk, is not supported.
